news.title: F Mec International Financial Services Limited Considers and Approves Change in Designation of Mr. Kabeer Choudhary as an Executive Director, Effective April 08, 2026
news.body: F Mec International Financial Services Limited informed that the meeting of the Board of Directors held on April 08, 2026 inter-alia considered and approved the Change in designation of Mr. Kabeer Choudhary (DIN: 03142141) as an Executive Director of the Company with effect from April 08, 2026.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 24%
news.body: After last week's 24% share price gain to ₹77.92, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 40.1x. Average trailing P/E is 20x in the Diversified Financial industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 268% over the past three years.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.8% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (currently running at an operating cash loss). news.body: After last week's 30% share price decline to ₹72.28, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 37.2x. Average trailing P/E is 21x in the Diversified Financial industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 241% over the past three years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.82 (vs ₹0.49 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.82 (up from ₹0.49 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹23.9m (up 61% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹7.28m (up 67% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 31% (up from 29% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 31% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 72% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: New major risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$10m. Market cap: ₹868.3m (US$9.47m) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook.
